name: dry_run:log-cart-app-warn-timeout-calling-inventory-65c2:b54f0027
query:
fetch logs, from: -24h, samplingRatio: 100
| filter service.name == "cart"
| summarize scope_records = count() * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    target_records = countIf(service.name == "cart" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "WARN" and matchesPhrase(content, "Timeout calling inventory")) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    matched_records = countIf(service.name == "cart" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "WARN" and matchesPhrase(content, "Timeout calling inventory") and not matchesPhrase(content, "InventoryClient.reserve")) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    outside_target = countIf((service.name == "cart" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "WARN" and matchesPhrase(content, "Timeout calling inventory") and not matchesPhrase(content, "InventoryClient.reserve")) and not (service.name == "cart" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "WARN" and matchesPhrase(content, "Timeout calling inventory"))) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio),
    matched_errors = countIf((service.name == "cart" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "WARN" and matchesPhrase(content, "Timeout calling inventory") and not matchesPhrase(content, "InventoryClient.reserve")) and in(loglevel, {"ERROR", "FATAL"})) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio)
